messages:
jordan: heads up — designing telemetry for the new Privilege Explorer in the console. need input on which events to emit + PII considerations. thoughts?

emily: high-level: capture open/view, filter changes, preview effective permissions, and export/copy actions. include tenant hash, admin_role, route_viewed. do NOT send raw emails.

lee: agree. also capture perf metrics: render time, query latency, backend permission-eval duration. console feels laggy when previewing lots of principals. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

devon: quick Q — do we send full principal lists for effective perms? that could be huge. maybe send counts + a small sample.

jordan: yeah, don't send full lists. proposal: events like `priv_exp_open`, `priv_exp_filter`, `priv_exp_preview`, `priv_exp_export` with payloads. sample payload in a bit.

jordan: ```
{
  "event": "priv_exp_preview",
  "tenant_id_h": "sha256(tenant-salt + id)",
  "user_id_h": "sha256(user-salt + id)",
  "role_name": "billing-admin",
  "result_count": 234,
  "sample_principals": ["u_h_1","u_h_2","u_h_3"],
  "eval_latency_ms": 120,
  "ui_render_ms": 85
}
```

sam: sampling rule: default sample 1% when result_count > 1000, but capture full breakdown for debug sessions (opt-in). GDPR: hash user ids with tenant-scoped salt, store only hashes.

infra-bot: Datadog: created monitor INF-237 tracking `priv_exp_preview` latency > 1000ms. Notified #eng-oncall.

emily: cost/retention note: high-cardinality raw events should have 30d retention, aggregates 365d. drop ephemeral fields after aggregation.

lee: UI note — don't emit on every keystroke. debounce filter events to 300ms and only send if results change. reduces noise a lot.

devon: API shape question: should console call `permissions/evaluate` directly and attach eval result, or emit an event referencing an `eval_id` so backend logs can be correlated? prefer the latter for traceability.

jordan: decision sketch: implement events above, sample principal lists when > threshold, hash user ids with tenant salt, debounce filter events, retention 30d for raw. also emit `eval_id` on `priv_exp_preview` for correlation. I'll open a PR with spec + example dashboard.

sam: sgtm. will review PR for telemetry quotas and cost caps. :thumbsup:

emily: mockup + spec here: https://redwood.ai/internal/priv-exp/spec (internal)

jordan: thanks — quick final: anyone against storing `role_name` plaintext in events? it's low-card and useful for rollups/telemetry.

devon: role_name is fine. avoid storing free-text role_description or user-facing notes.

emily: +1

jordan: great — filing follow-ups: PR (#4021), dashboard panel request, and a short runbook for oncall if eval latency spikes. will ping owners. thanks everyone!
